import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    possible = True
    while m != 0 and possible:
        d = m % w
        if d == 0 or d == 1:
            m //= w
        elif d == w - 1:
            m = (m + 1) // w
        else:
            possible = False
    sys.stdout.write("YES" if possible else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
